description: This file defines the Query class for constructing and executing SQL entity queries within Drupal's core entity API, including methods for preparing, compiling, sorting, and executing queries, as well as handling revisions and metadata.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Entity\Query\Sql\Query
classes.description: Class for building and executing SQL queries for Drupal entities, supporting revision handling, sorting, grouping, and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Query object with entity type, conjunction, database connection, and namespaces.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the built query and returns the result.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the base query with metadata, tags, and base fields, handling revisions and metadata.

methods.name: addSort
methods.description: Adds sorting to the query based on specified sort conditions.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the query by adding fields, groupings, and range.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the query result as entity IDs, either as a count or keyed array.

methods.name: getSqlField
methods.description: Constructs a SQL expression for a given field and language.

methods.name: isSimpleQuery
methods.description: Determines if the query is simple enough to avoid complex grouping and aggregation.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Resets fields and groupings when cloning the query object.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns the Tables object for managing table joins and fields.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the query to a SQL string with arguments quoted and table names prefixed.
